note: Two reusable rule candidates came out of the story-030 review findings; no fallow or complaint signal was present.

candidates.text: When moving from server-rendered SvelteKit to a static export, replace every server-side auth/session check with a client-side guard so protected routes are not exposed as static HTML.
candidates.rationale: Switching to `adapter-static` disabled `hooks.server.ts` in production, so `/tasks` lost its server-side redirect. Adding a `+layout.ts` client-side load guard restored that protection.

candidates.text: Centralize environment-dependent values such as API base URLs in one module and import them everywhere, rather than duplicating env fallbacks across client and server code.
candidates.rationale: `hooks.server.ts` had its own `apiBaseUrl` fallback that drifted from `config.ts`. Importing the canonical value removed the duplication and kept dev behavior consistent.
